medications.name: Metoprolol Succinate
medications.instructions: take one tablet by mouth twice daily

medications.name: Lisinopril
medications.instructions: take one tablet by mouth once daily

medications.name: Furosemide
medications.instructions: take one tablet by mouth once daily in the morning

medications.name: Metformin
medications.instructions: take one tablet by mouth twice daily with meals

medications.name: Atorvastatin
medications.instructions: take one tablet by mouth at bedtime

follow_up_instructions.description: Follow up with Dr. Patel (Cardiology) in 2 weeks
Follow up with Dr. Chen (Primary Care) in 1 week
Daily weight monitoring — weigh yourself every morning before breakfast, call if weight increases more than 3 lbs in 2 days
Low-sodium diet — limit to less than 2,000mg sodium per day
Fluid restriction — no more than 2 liters of fluid per day
